snippet.title: Shoot The Barrels - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4332150/Shoot_The_Barrels/

Shoot exploding barrels in this satisfying incremental game! Upgrade your stats, buy new weapons, and improve your power ups, such as the dual wield and the one-hit RPG!
